Method of Attack: Injected cryptojacking script via AOL advertising platform ad slots to load an in-browser cryptocurrency miner that utilized users' CPU resources to mine Monero
Used obfuscated Coinhive in-browser mining script loaded from a newly registered domain to avoid detection and blacklisting
Used a private mining pool to avoid fees
Impacted Systems: over 500 websites including Microsoft's MSN portal
Attack Vector: Malicious ads injected via advertising.aolp.jp AOL advertising platform
Indicators of Compromise: high CPU usage on affected systems
